ctx.x: That Peggy Lee did the lyric for right?

Right, that was done after the movie, we realized we had something that could be a song and Peggy Lee did an amazing thing, to me. She is a very intuitive lady, but I gave her this theme and I asked her, “Would you like to write a lyric to it?” And she said, “Yes,” and she wrote it and it was written for – and I saw the lyric and I said, “How did you do that,” she said, “how did I do what?” I said, “This song which I didn’t tell you about was actually written for a scene that takes place in a movie called, The…
